10043-klondyke-nuggets-a-brief-descripti.title: Territories and Alaska
10043-klondyke-nuggets-a-brief-descripti.creator: Unknown
10043-klondyke-nuggets-a-brief-descripti.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. * * * * *   KLONDYKE NUGGETS   CHAPTER I. The word and place that has startled the civilized world is to-day a series of thriving mining camps on the Yukon River and its tributaries in the Canadian Northwest Territories. Prior to August 24, 1896, this section of the country had never been heard of. It was on this day that a man named Henderson discovered the first gold.

arxiv-1502-05087.title: Computation of the O ⁡ ( p 6 ) O(p^{6}) order low-energy constants: an update
arxiv-1502-05087.creator: Shao-Zhou Jiang, Zhen-Long Wei, Qing-Sen Chen, Qing Wang
arxiv-1502-05087.description: Abstract We update our original low-energy constants to the O ⁡ ( p 6 ) O(p^{6}) order, including two and three flavours, the normal and anomalous ones. Following a comparative analysis, the O ⁡ ( p 4 ) O(p^{4}) results are considered better.

arxiv-2109-14061.title: The impact of non-target events in synthetic soundscapes for sound event detection
arxiv-2109-14061.description: Abstract Detection and Classification Acoustic Scene and Events Challenge 2021 Task 4 uses a heterogeneous dataset that includes both recorded and synthetic soundscapes. Until recently only target sound events were considered when synthesizing the soundscapes. However, recorded soundscapes often contain a substantial amount of non-target events that may affect the performance.

arxiv-2202-10238.title: Virtual cycles on projective completions and quantum Lefschetz formula
arxiv-2202-10238.creator: Jeongseok Oh
arxiv-2202-10238.description: Abstract . For a compact quasi-smooth derived scheme M M with ( − 1 ) (-1) -shifted cotangent bundle N N , there are at least two ways to localise the virtual cycle of N N to M M via torus and cosection localisations, introduced by Jiang-Thomas [ JT ] .

arxiv-2205-13489.title: Measuring Perceptual Color Differences of Smartphone Photographs
arxiv-2205-13489.creator: Zhihua Wang, Keshuo Xu, Yang Yang, Jianlei Dong, Shuhang Gu, Lihao Xu, Yuming Fang, Kede Ma
arxiv-2205-13489.description: Abstract Measuring perceptual color differences (CDs) is of great importance in modern smartphone photography. Despite the long history, most CD measures have been constrained by psychophysical data of homogeneous color patches or a limited number of simplistic natural photographic images.

arxiv-2208-12858.title: Molecular Fraction in the Galactic Center: The Central Molecular and HI Zones 2022
arxiv-2208-12858.creator: Yoshiaki Sofue
arxiv-2208-12858.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Yoshiaki Sofue. By mapping the molecular fraction of the Galactic Center (GC), we quantitatively address the question of how much molecular and central the CMZ (Central Molecular Zone) is. For this purpose we analyze the CO and HI-line archival data, and determine the column- (surface-) and volume-molecular fractions, f mol Σ f_{\rm mol}^{\Sigma} and f mol ρ f_{\rm mol}^{\rho} , which are the ratio of column-mass density of H 2 projected on the sky to that of total gas (H 2 + HI) from

arxiv-2212-08948.title: Geometrically contracted structure in teleparallel f ⁡ ( T ) f(T) gravity
arxiv-2212-08948.creator: A. R. P. Moreira, F. C. E. Lima, C. A. S. Almeida
arxiv-2212-08948.description: Abstract In the teleparallel f ⁡ ( T ) f(T) gravity scenario, we consider a five-dimensional thick brane. This scenario is interesting because this theory can provide explanations for inflation, radiation and dark matter under certain conditions. It is convenient to assume, for our study, a polynomial profile of the function f ⁡ ( T ) f(T) .

arxiv-2302-05718.title: Synergies between Venus & Exoplanetary Observations
arxiv-2302-05718.creator: M.J. Way, Colby Ostberg, Bradford J. Foley, Cedric Gillmann, Dennis Höning, Helmut Lammer, Joseph O’Rourke, Moa Persson, Ana-Catalina Plesa, Arnaud Salvador, Manuel Scherf, Matthew Weller
arxiv-2302-05718.description: Abstract In this chapter we examine how our knowledge of present day Venus can inform terrestrial exoplanetary science and how exoplanetary science can inform our study of Venus. In a superficial way the contrasts in knowledge appear stark. We have been looking at Venus for millennia and studying it via telescopic observations for centuries.

arxiv-2306-07033.title: When Vision Fails: Text Attacks Against ViT and OCR
arxiv-2306-07033.creator: Nicholas Boucher, Jenny Blessing, Ilia Shumailov, Ross Anderson, Nicolas Papernot
arxiv-2306-07033.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Nicholas Boucher, Jenny Blessing, Ilia Shumailov, Ross Anderson, Nicolas Papernot. While text-based machine learning models that operate on visual inputs of rendered text have become robust against a wide range of existing attacks, we show that they are still vulnerable to visual adversarial examples encoded as text. We use the Unicode functionality of combining diacritical marks to manipulate encoded text so that small visual perturbations appear when the text is rendered.

arxiv-2312-16267.title: Maximizing the Success Probability of Policy Allocations in Online Systems
arxiv-2312-16267.creator: Artem Betlei, Mariia Vladimirova, Mehdi Sebbar, Nicolas Urien, Thibaud Rahier, Benjamin Heymann
arxiv-2312-16267.description: Abstract The effectiveness of advertising in e-commerce largely depends on the ability of merchants to bid on and win impressions for their targeted users. The bidding procedure is highly complex due to various factors such as market competition, user behavior, and the diverse objectives of advertisers.

arxiv-2402-14881.title: A Study on the Vulnerability of Test Questions against ChatGPT-based Cheating
arxiv-2402-14881.creator: Shanker Ram, Chen Qian
arxiv-2402-14881.description: Abstract ChatGPT is a chatbot that can answer text prompts fairly accurately, even performing very well on postgraduate-level questions. Many educators have found that their take-home or remote tests and exams are vulnerable to ChatGPT-based cheating because students may directly use answers provided by tools like ChatGPT.

arxiv-2404-04802.title: Bright Star Subtraction Pipeline for LSST: Progress Review
arxiv-2404-04802.creator: Amir E. Bazkiaei, Lee S. Kelvin, Sarah Brough, Simon J. O’Toole, Aaron Watkins, Morgen A. Schmitz
arxiv-2404-04802.description: Abstract We present the Bright Star Subtraction (BSS) pipeline for the Vera C. Rubin Observatory’s Legacy Survey of Space and Time (LSST). This pipeline generates an extended PSF model using observed stars and subtracts the model from the bright stars in LSST data.

arxiv-2406-03676.title: Revisiting the accretion disc spectra of Dwarf Novae and Novalike variables: implications for the standard disc model
arxiv-2406-03676.creator: Gabriella Zsidi, C. J. Nixon, T. Naylor, J. E. Pringle
arxiv-2406-03676.description: Abstract Accretion discs are fundamental to much of astronomy. They can occur around stars both young and old, around compact objects they provide a window into the extremes of physics, and around supermassive black holes in galaxy centres they generate spectacular luminosities that can outshine the entire galaxy.

arxiv-2411-07328.title: Proxy-small objects present compactly generated categories
arxiv-2411-07328.creator: Benjamin Briggs, Srikanth B. Iyengar, Greg Stevenson
arxiv-2411-07328.description: Abstract . We develop a correspondence between presentations of compactly generated triangulated categories as localizations of derived categories of ring spectra and proxy-small objects, and explore some consequences. In addition, we give a characterization of proxy-smallness in terms of coproduct preservation of the associated corepresentable functor ‘up to base change’. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification 18G80 (primary); 13D09 (secondary) 1.

arxiv-2412-12080.title: The Mordell-Schinzel conjecture for cubic diophantine equations
arxiv-2412-12080.creator: János Kollár and Jennifer Li
arxiv-2412-12080.description: Abstract . Building on the works of Mordell (1952) and Schinzel (2015), we prove that cubic diophantine equations x ​ y ​ z = G ⁡ ( x , y ) xyz=G(x,y) have infinitely many solutions. Mordell stated [ Mor52 ] that the diophantine equation xyz=G(x,y) has infinitely many solutions for every polynomial G\in{\mathbb{Z}}[x,y] .

arxiv-2503-13505.title: Ensemble Learning for Large Language Models in Text and Code Generation: A Survey
arxiv-2503-13505.creator: Mari Ashiga, Wei Jie, Fan Wu, Vardan Voskanyan, Fateme Dinmohammadi, Paul Brookes, Jingzhi Gong, Zheng Wang
arxiv-2503-13505.description: Abstract Generative Pretrained Transformers (GPTs) are foundational Large Language Models (LLMs) for text generation. However, individual LLMs often produce inconsistent outputs and exhibit biases, limiting their representation of diverse language patterns. The closed-source nature of many powerful LLMs further restricts industry applications due to data privacy concerns.

arxiv-2601-00881.title: A Mathematical Model to Capture Urbanization Trajectory Induced by Economic Inequality
arxiv-2601-00881.creator: Neeraj Pandey, Abhineet Agarwal, Raju Roychowdhury, Karmeshu, Parth Pratim Pandey
arxiv-2601-00881.description: Abstract Analysis of the urban population fraction data for sixteen populous countries over the last fifty years reveals a universal increase in urbanization - exhibiting four qualitatively distinct temporal patterns: (i) continuously accelerating growth, (ii) continuously decelerating growth, (iii) two-phase growth transitioning from acceleration to deceleration, and (iv) two-phase growth transitioning from deceleration to acceleration.

plos-pone-0000657.title: Cadherin-9 Is a Novel Cell Surface Marker for the Heterogeneous Pool of Renal Fibroblasts
plos-pone-0000657.creator: Cornelia Thedieck, Hubert Kalbacher, Markus Kuczyk et al.
plos-pone-0000657.description: PLOS ONE research article. Interstitial fibroblasts are a minor, but nevertheless very important, component of the kidney. They secrete and remodel extracellular matrix and they produce active compounds such as erythropoietin. However, studying human renal fibroblasts has been hampered by the lack of appro

pmc-10604844.title: The Complicated Relationship of Short-Chain Fatty Acids and Oral Microbiome: A Narrative Review
pmc-10604844.creator: Georgy E. Leonov, Yurgita R. Varaeva, Elena N. Livantsova, Antonina V. Starodubova
pmc-10604844.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). The human oral microbiome has emerged as a focal point of research due to its profound implications for human health. The involvement of short-chain fatty acids in oral microbiome composition, oral health, and chronic inflammation is gaining increasing attention. In this narrative review, the results of early in vitro, in vivo, and pilot clinical studies and research projects are presented in order to define the boundaries of this new complicated issue.

pmc-11356500.title: Marginal Aggregates: The Role of Clays
pmc-11356500.creator: Arnon Bentur, Pavel Larianovsky
pmc-11356500.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Clays are components in the fine portion of aggregates, less than 75 microns in size (micro-fines), which are usually washed away when producing coarse or fine (manufactured sand) aggregates in quarries. When marginal sources of aggregates are being used, the content of this washed portion can be quite high, and there is an incentive to keep as much of it in the aggregate, including the clays.

pmc-11477290.title: The Expression of miR-211-5p in Sentinel Lymph Node Metastases of Malignant Melanoma Is a Potential Marker for Poor Prognosis †
pmc-11477290.creator: Rose Kathrin Caroline Moritz, Nicole Ebelt, Tina Rattay, Jovine Ehrenreich, Cord Sunderkötter, Dennis Gerloff, Marco Ragusa, Cristina Barbagallo
pmc-11477290.description: Metastatic primary cutaneous melanoma is a frequently fatal disease despite recent therapeutic advances. Biomarkers to stratify patients’ prognosis are lacking. MicroRNAs (miRNAs) are small, non-coding RNAs. We aimed to determine the expression of miR-211-5p in primary tumors and metastases of malignant melanoma and its potential use as a prognostic biomarker.

pmc-11534182.title: Lung cancer associated with partial anomalous pulmonary venous connection in the non-resected lobe: A case report
pmc-11534182.creator: Yuuki Matsui, Koji Takami
pmc-11534182.description: Introduction and importancePartial anomalous pulmonary venous connection (PAPVC) is a relatively rare congenital vascular anomaly that complicates the surgical management of lung cancer and other lung lesions.Case presentationA 74-year-old woman underwent computed tomography (CT) during an episode of chest trauma.

pmc-12642354.title: Evolution of pneumococcal serotype 19A in children in Bangladesh: insights from genomic analysis
pmc-12642354.creator: Arif Mohammad Tanmoy, Esha Kazi, Naito Kanon, Hafizur Rahman, Harry C.H. Hung, Md Hasanuzzaman, Roly Malaker, Apurba Rajib Malaker, Deb Purna Keya, Sudipta Deb Nath, Belal Hossain, Shampa Saha, Mohammad Jamal Uddin, Lesley McGee, Stephen D. Bentley, Stephanie W. Lo, Yogesh Hooda, Samir K. Saha, Senj
pmc-12642354.description: BackgroundInvasive pneumococcal disease (IPD), caused by Streptococcus pneumoniae, remains a major global health concern, particularly for children. Among more than 100 pneumococcal serotypes, 19A is known for its multidrug resistance (MDR) and increased incidence following PCV7/PCV10 introduction in many countries. Bangladesh introduced PCV10 in 2015 considering the low burden of 19A in the country.

pmc-12652221.title: DNA Barcoding Identification of Angelicae Sinensis Radix and Its Adulterants Based on Internal Transcribed Spacer 2 Region and Secondary Structure Prediction
pmc-12652221.creator: Zifeng Chen, Qiman Zeng, Meihui Gong, Huimin Wu, Wenli Chen, Xinjun Xu, Bin Yu
pmc-12652221.description: Background: Morphological similarities among Angelicae Sinensis Radix and related species often lead to market substitution. This study develops a DNA barcoding method to authenticate these herbs and identify adulterants derived from Angelica, Heracleum, and Peucedanum genera. Methods: Phylogenetic analysis was conducted using MEGA 11.

pmc-12655307.title: Synthesis of Straw-Based Hydrothermal Carbonation Carbon and Its Photocatalytic Removal of Cr(VI) and Microcystin-LR
pmc-12655307.creator: Yu Luo, Xunxian Chen, Zhen Wan, Yingming Chen, Isabella Natali Sora
pmc-12655307.description: As a cost-effective and environmentally benign photocatalyst, hydrothermal carbonation carbon (HTCC) has been extensively studied in the fields of resource utilization and environmental remediation. In this study, HTCC photocatalysts with efficient photocatalytic performances were prepared from straw using acid modification under hydrothermal conditions. The as-prepared HTCC photocatalysts were applied to the degradation of microcystin-LR and the reduction of aqueous Cr(VI).

pmc-12661726.title: The health-driven security for older adults with partial dependency in activities of daily living who experience loneliness: a research and development
pmc-12661726.creator: Phatchanun Vivarakanon, Puangpet Meesiri, Wanida Intharacha, Jitaree Chatmontree, Sriprapi Inchithep
pmc-12661726.description: BackgroundHealth security is an important aspects affecting quality of life, particularly older people who live independently. This research and development aimed to: 1) assess the current health security situation, 2) develop a health-driven security model, and 3) evaluate the effectiveness of the developed model.

pmc-12697235.title: Prognostic Value of Antiarrhythmic Drug Suppression of Electrical Storm Prior to Ventricular Tachycardia Ablation
pmc-12697235.creator: Rafik Issa, Osama El‐Sayed, Mohammed Al‐Sadawi, Muazzum Shah, Kelly Arps, Amrish Deshmukh, Michael Ghannam, Rakesh Latchamsetty, Krit Jongnarangsin, Thomas Crawford, Aman Chugh, Hakan Oral, Fred Morady, Frank Bogun, Jackson J Liang
pmc-12697235.description: IntroductionEarly ablation after electrical storm (ES) has been associated with improved ventricular tachycardia (VT)‐free survival. Antiarrhythmic drugs (AAD) can acutely temper ES in some patients allowing for delayed elective ablation, but they may be ineffective in other patients, who may require urgent ablation.

pmc-13386705.title: Carotid body measurement by computed tomography angiography: a cross-sectional population-based study
pmc-13386705.creator: Negin Faghih Dolatabadi, Paria Bolourinejad, Fatemeh Dashti, Somayeh Hajiahmadi
pmc-13386705.description: BackgroundCarotid bodies (CBs) are chemoreceptors located at the bifurcation of the common carotid arteries, playing an essential role in maintaining blood gas homeostasis and regulating cardiovascular function. CBs are increasingly affected in various systemic pathologies, particularly those involving sympathetic overactivation, including hypertension and heart failure. Despite CB hypertrophy in these conditions has been well-studied, normative data on dimensions remain scarce.

pmc-13388897.title: Prevalence and experiences of presenteeism in the workplace: a cross-sectional survey of an English National Health Service Mental Health Trust
pmc-13388897.creator: Jennifer Sweetman, Mona Kanaan, Sarah Morris, Helen Cooke, Angela Collins, Emily Shoesmith, Elena Ratschen
pmc-13388897.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). IntroductionPresenteeism (working while unwell) is prevalent in the English National Health Service (NHS) workforce and is associated with substantial costs. Currently little is known about the relationship between presenteeism and staff wellbeing within the NHS.

pmc-13468128.title: Toward personalized medicine in AD/ADRD through genetic-exposome dementia risk assessments
pmc-13468128.creator: Paulina Tolosa-Tort, Meri Okorie, Aadrita Chatterjee, Ana I Boeriu, Rakshya U Sharma, Shea J Andrews
pmc-13468128.description: Genetic-Exposome Dementia Risk Assessments (GEDRA) integrate genomic and environmental risk factors into actionable, patient-centered tools for Alzheimer’s disease and related dementias (AD/ADRD). By enabling midlife risk stratification before biomarker or cognitive changes, GEDRA supports personalized medicine through targeted screening, tailored interventions, treatment guidance, and proactive planning.

pmc-13553583.title: Islamic lifesaving human milk donation model for small and sick preterm: Policy development
pmc-13553583.creator: Dua' Y Al-Maharma, Hanan Sabah, Waddah Demeh
pmc-13553583.description: BackgroundPremature birth predisposes preterm infants to life-threatening complications. Donor human milk is as effective as a mother's own milk when mothers cannot produce enough milk. In Islam, receiving donor human milk creates a milk kinship that imposes religious restrictions. Therefore, Muslim countries have made limited efforts to develop human milk donation policies that meet international standards and Islamic regulations.

pmc-13614716.title: How human and animal frailty index studies can inform each other: a brief narrative review
pmc-13614716.creator: Andrew Rutenberg, Kenneth Rockwood
pmc-13614716.description: Frailty is common in older people, who are much more often studied than older animals. This makes it less surprising that research in frailty largely began with insights from humans before being translated into frailty in animals. Back translation from animal models to humans followed. Here, we review this interplay.

pmc-13633939.title: Stimulated single-fiber electromyography in the diagnostic workup of diplopia and ptosis
pmc-13633939.creator: Sara Cornacchini, Massimiliano Ugo Verza, Gregorio Spagni, Francesca Beretta, Antonio Farina, Maria Bastianelli, Annalisa Cassardo, Cristina Mei, Antonio Lotti, Alessandro Barilaro, Luca Massacesi, Valentina Damato, Antonello Grippo
pmc-13633939.description: ObjectivePtosis and diplopia are common neuro-ophthalmological presentations with a broad differential diagnosis. In clinical practice, stimulated single-fiber electromyography (SFEMG) is often requested when ocular myasthenia gravis (MG) remains a diagnostic consideration after initial evaluation. This study evaluated the diagnostic contribution of stimulated SFEMG in a real-world cohort of patients referred with ptosis and/or diplopia.
